newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas untraded again, bids/offers miles apart.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas untraded again, bids/offers miles apart.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were untraded yet again on Friday morning, rounding off a miserable week for the contract.

Bids and offers were wide apart for all 12 contract months by the midday close of the morning session. In all but one month, the bids and offers stood either side of the previous settlement, indicating a lack of price movement following the sharp fall on the OTC market on Thursday.
The exception was September, the only month to trade on Thursday, where both bids and offers came off from the previous settlement price.
Front month June was bid at 10.35 pence and offered at 11.35 pence by the close, with July and August bid and offered slightly higher.
Only four deals have been done in the whole week, with one futures broker saying, "This week has been a disaster, quite frankly."
